question: Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G live in a seven-floor building. The lowermost floor is numbered as 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7. Only four people live below the floor on which D lives. Only two people live below C. B lives on the lowermost floor. E lives immediately above B. A lives on one of the floors above F but on one of the floors below G. Who lives on the floor numbered 4?
solution:
Seven people A, B, C, D, E, F and G live in a seven-floor building. The lowermost floor is numbered as 1, the floor above it is numbered 2, and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 7.

1) Only four people live below the floor on which D lives and Only two people live below C and B lives on the lowermost floor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/392c1f4aafcb7a13881fe4d1ef8d5c453018f26ca9003823d9a4bd0cfab27334.png] 

2) E lives immediately above B and A lives on one of the floors above F but on one of the floors below G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3faad4f4f554fb4c619ef088664f476700e6d1a9444db1280af9faf748fffcd.png] 

∴ Here, 'F' lives on floor numbered four.

Hence, the correct answer is **"F".**
